notes.title: PaperPixel Games Bundle is here!
notes.content:
As a small indie team, every game we create is a labor of love, and we’re excited to bring [b]Insight [/b]and [b]Toy Shop Simulator[/b] together in one special bundle. This is your chance to experience the heart and soul we’ve poured into these games, now at a discounted price. Thank you for supporting our journey—your encouragement means the world to us! 💛

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49631/PaperPixel_Games/

notes.title: The Steam Autumn Sale is here! Get 25% off on Insight right now! 🎉🎉
notes.content:
In case if you dont know, Insight is a single-player horror story game shrouded in mystery. You'll take control of different characters to solve crimes and unveil the dark secrets behind them.
